title: 15 date ideas to try this month

slides.title: 15 date ideas to try *this month*
slides.sub: Screenshot it. Tick them off one by one.

items.text: A *farmers market* morning, then cook lunch with what you find
A *yes day*: one plans everything, the other says yes
A *double date* brunch with your favorite couple
*Paint and sip* at home, frame the results
A *five-course tasting menu* at home, tiny portions only
Order *blind* at a cuisine you’ve never tried
*Roller or ice skating*, hand in hand (for balance)
A *bike ride* to somewhere you’ve never been
An *escape room*. Find out who panics
Shoot a *one-minute film* on your phones
A *staycation* night at a hotel in your own city
